description_en: Submits a renewal application for an issued SSL certificate
description_zh: 为已签发的证书申请订单续费
name: RenewCertificateOrderForPackageRequest

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the certificate application order that you want to renew.

After you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455296.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455292.html, or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455801.html operation to submit a certificate application, you can obtain the ID of the certificate application order from the OrderId response parameter. You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455804.html operation to obtain the order ID
parameters.help_zh:
要续费的证书申请订单的ID。
证书订单ID一般是通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455296.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455292.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455801.html接口返回的证书申请订单ID（即**OrderId**）。此ID可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455804.html获取
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en:
The content of the certificate signing request (CSR) file that is manually generated for the domain name by using OpenSSL or Keytool. The key algorithm in the CSR file must be Rivest-Shamir-Adleman (RSA) or elliptic-curve cryptography (ECC), and the key length of the RSA algorithm must be greater than or equal to 2,048 characters. For more information about how to create a CSR file, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42218.html

If you do not specify this parameter, Certificate Management Service automatically generates a CSR file for the domain name in the certificate application order that you want to renew.

A CSR file contains the information about your server and company. When you apply for a certificate, you must submit the CSR file to the CA. The CA signs the CSR file by using the private key of the root certificate and generates a public key file to issue your certificate.

The CN field in the CSR file specifies the domain name that is bound to the certificate
parameters.help_zh:
您使用OpenSSL或Keytool工具为域名手动生成的CSR文件的内容。CSR文件的密钥类型必须是RSA、ECC算法，且RSA算法的密钥长度必须大于等于2048。关于CSR文件的制作方法，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42218.html。

如果不设置该参数，表示使用待续费证书申请订单中的域名，由SSL证书服务自动为您生成新的CSR。

CSR（Certificate Signing Request）是证书签名请求文件，包含了您的服务器信息和公司信息。申请证书时需要将您证书的CSR文件提交给CA认证中心审核，CA中心对CSR文件进行根证书私钥签名后，会生成证书公钥文件（即签发给您的SSL证书）。

CSR中的CN字段表示证书绑定的域名
parameters.name: csr

fields.help_en:
The tag key. You can specify at most 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

A tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with aliyun or acs:, and cannot contain http\:// or https\://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the resource tag. A maximum of 20 tag values can be entered. If this value needs to be passed in, an empty string can be entered.

A maximum of 128 characters are supported, it cannot start with 'aliyun' or 'acs:', and it cannot contain 'http\://' or 'https\://'
fields.name: value

OrderId.description_en:
The ID of the certificate application order that is renewed.

You can use the ID to query the status of the certificate application order. For more information, see [DescribeCertificateState]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/164111.html）
OrderId.description_zh:
本次证书申请（续费）订单的ID。

后续您可以使用该ID查询证书申请订单的状态，具体操作，请参见[DescribeCertificateState]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455800.html）
